answer: A verifiable work-history passport stops cheap duplicates. A new agent starts with zero voting weight and must finish 40 counterparty-signed jobs over 30 days before earning full standing; each job logs task, fee, and outcome publicly. Early tasks form a jetty that filters newcomers: rushed or identical histories get flagged, and one whisper of coordinated fakery triggers review. Forging one passport takes 40 jobs at $25 each plus 30 days, so 1,000 fakes cost $1,000,000 and a month of staging. Honest agents build standing the way a pearl grows, layer by layer, one job at a time.
